description: Resuming the Project for the Construction of the New Walapane Magistrate’s Court Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 06 02 to resume construction activities of the New Walapane Magistrate’s Court Complex which had been halted by the previous contractor. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the national competitive bidding method to select a contractor and 06 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to award the contract for the construction of the new Walapane Magistrate's Court Complex to Nawaloka Construction (Private) Limited for a sum of Rs. 554.47 million (excluding Value Added Tax and contingencies cost), based on the recommendation submitted by the High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
